desc: Being safe and responsible is a cornerstone of the Ruger philosophy. With over 70 years of innovation and quality, Ruger offers the attention to detail expected from an industry leader, providing you with reliable gun cases, packs, and accessory gear. Upholding the very best in craftmanship, you will have the peace of mind needed to protect your investment when hitting the field or range. The Ruger 10/22 Passive Earmuffs & Shooting Glasses Combo is the perfect duo to remain safe out on the range or field. Keep your view free from distractions with the shooting glasses, providing a full panoramic view. Built with a high-impact polycarbonate lens and UV protection, these glasses provide the ultimate protection over the eyes and face while reducing scratches from wear and tear. Glasses are highly rated, meeting the American National Standards Institute (ANSI) Z87.1+. The earmuffs have a Noise Reduction Rating (NRR) of 23 decibels, rated to cancel out shooting noise when you’re out on the range or field. The soft foam ear cups provide additional comfort and can be worn for a long period of time. The padded headband is easy to adjust and are made to fit all sizes. Choose safety and convenience with The Ruger 10/22 Passive Earmuffs & Shooting Glasses Combo to ensure your eyes and ears stay safe at the shooting range.
